integrity: Integer and exact-rational exhaustive subset recursions, independent occupied-state recursion, five-vertex motif census, and complete conditional mean certificate; scientific statements reproducible from included source files. This is a same-model evaluation, not external certification.
scientific_limitations: Only the named twenty-site graphs and independent single-attempt exponential-rate-one irreversible adsorption. No general girth ordering or stochastic order of terminal sizes; historical exact computations might be unindexed. The full 1989 Pippenger paper was unavailable for full-text examination.
title: Strict all-time monomer-adsorption ordering of two cubic twenty-site networks
